title: The error prefactor for sequential discrimination of trine states
scope: Equiprobable pure qubit trine. One pass over identical copies with classical memory. The ratio of sequential to collective minimum errors tends to two.
question: Error-ratio formulation of the Vienna geometrically uniform states question.
verification: AI-assisted same-agent mathematical review, fresh exact-arithmetic controls and frozen-check replay. Independent expert review and priority remain open.
source_credit: The converse follows from Montanaro (2008), Theorem 1, applied to the first-copy posterior. The antitrine and binary continuation and the collective benchmark are established tools.

checks.arithmetic: rational arithmetic and integer square-root enclosures
